title: LocalDbReady.v1
description: Emitted when the local database is ready for reads/writes. Carries the cold-start duration so the /system Database tile can show readiness latency.

coldStartMs.description: Wall-clock duration from the start of bootstrap to the ready signal, in milliseconds.
coldStartMs.markdownDescription: Wall-clock duration from the start of bootstrap to the ready signal, in milliseconds.

opfsAvailable.description: True when OPFS is available; false on memory-only fallback browsers.
opfsAvailable.markdownDescription: True when OPFS is available; false on memory-only fallback browsers.
